prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Last spring when I was in Shanghai, I remember we kept joking that the whole trip revolved around eating.
Earlier in that same stretch, my coworker had flown from Beijing to Shanghai for a meeting, and I tagged along for part of it.
And then later we did a separate little getaway in Hangzhou—mostly just to slow down for a couple days.
One night in Shanghai we ended up at Xiao Nan Guo, and the table was under Zhou Jun with that phone number 13813897597.
I still remember the dinner details because it was so hectic: it was on 2025-04-29 at 19:00, and there were 4 of us squeezed in.
For the flight piece, the ticket my colleague already had was MU5678 on China Eastern, dated 2025-05-03.
Everything was under Xie Peng back then—both that flight booking and the Hangzhou stay at West Lake State Guesthouse, checking in 2025-05-12 for 3 nights.
